# PNet

> > PNet is South Africa's leading online career portal connecting job seekers with employers across diverse industries including corporate services, facilities management, and construction.

PNet serves as the primary recruitment platform for major South African corporations and employers, offering job search functionality, CV uploads, and career opportunities across multiple sectors. The platform hosts dedicated career portals for major corporate groups including Bidvest Group, GUD Holdings, and Cosmopolitan Projects.

## Key Topics

## Main Career Portal

- [PNet Home](https://careers.pnet.co.za/): Main PNet careers portal homepage for job search and recruitment services across South Africa

## Corporate Career Portals

- [Bidvest Group Careers](https://bidvest.pnet.co.za/): Bidvest Group careers including facilities management, airport services, cargo handling, and lounge operations at major South African airports
- [GUD Holdings Careers](https://gudholdings.pnet.co.za/): Career opportunities and company culture information for GUD Holdings in South Africa
- [Cosmopolitan Projects Careers](https://cosmopolitancareers.pnet.co.za/): Job opportunities in residential housing development and construction with Cosmopolitan Projects
